locations.label: Spawn power
locations.description: Switch on all five regional supplies: the Spawn employee room by the M1; Journey’s Star Mission/Rover Rampage hallway; Astrocade left of its portal; Polar Peak by Quickies; and Moonlight Cafe upstairs in Kepler. Each switch powers only its own region. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Projector Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Activate and travel through Journey, Astrocade, Polar Peak Gift Shop and Kepler’s stair-base portals. The four hub indicators turn blue. Enter Cosmic Way’s central portal to reach the projector; it returns you after its visit window and needs to cool down before reuse. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Gator teeth / crystal targets
locations.description: Buy Golden Teeth for 300 tickets. Lure a Brute into Kepler’s gator mouth so its teeth break, then fit the replacements. Shoot the throat targets with matching elemental cores: left to right Wind, Electric, Laser, Fire. Take the matching crystal for your selected Weapon of Rock. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Speakers / alien fight
locations.description: Place speakers on Cosmic Way’s three golden region symbols and in front of the projector gateway. Prepare before interacting with a speaker: activation seals you inside the Cosmic Way/Spawn arena. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
